errors.text_span: illustrating the monthly calendar-adjusted base indices for manufactured pharmaceutical substances and products in Bulgaria for the years 2022, 2023, and 2024, with the base year set at 2021=100
errors.evidence: The chart does not indicate that it represents pharmaceutical substances or products, nor does it mention a base year of 2021=100. The reference description states that the chart illustrates percentage values for three years across months.
The machine-generated description does not state that the chart represents percentage values for three years (2022, 2023, 2024) across months, as indicated in the reference.
The bars are grouped side by side for each month, not stacked. The machine description incorrectly describes the arrangement of the bars.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the highest value is in December 2022, exceeding 120,000, and the lowest value is in December and July 2023, at 80,000.
The machine-generated description does not highlight that 2024 generally has the highest values across the months, as stated in the reference.
